title: SelCal M6-P1 artifact contract v4 proposal
description: Closed proposal schema preserving revision 3 while repairing observed-failure, comparison-cardinality, streamed-diagnostic, identity, custody, and semantic-binding defects.
x-claimCeiling: Schema validity establishes local structural conformance only. Cross-record counts, digest domains, canonical float round trips, execution history, analytical agreement, scientific validation, M6 completion, release approval, and SoftwareX readiness require the named semantic verifier and real evidence.

x-canonicalization.jsonObjectBytes: UTF-8 bytes of json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')); JSON files have no BOM and no trailing LF
x-canonicalization.jsonlRowBytes: canonical JSON object bytes followed by exactly one LF byte; no blank rows; final row also has LF
x-canonicalization.fileSha256Domain: all raw bytes from byte zero through EOF
x-canonicalization.rowSha256Domain: one complete canonical JSONL row including its terminating LF
x-canonicalization.ledgerSha256Domain: raw chunk bytes concatenated in ascending chunkIndex without separators
x-canonicalization.projectionSha256Domain: canonical productionProjection object bytes without LF
x-canonicalization.floatSemanticRoundTrip: Every FloatHex value must decode to a finite IEEE-754 binary64 value and Python float.fromhex(value).hex() must equal value exactly, including signed zero; schema pattern matching alone is insufficient
x-canonicalization.noSelfHash: No artifact contains its own byte digest. contractBinding identifies the governing schema and upstream contracts only; terminal manifests bind other artifacts but never themselves

x-semanticVerifier.name: verify_m6_p1_artifact_contract_v4_semantics
requirements: recompute every descriptor byte count and SHA-256 over its declared byte domain and reject a self hash in contractBinding
require every FloatHex to be finite binary64 and to satisfy float.fromhex(value).hex() == value exactly, including signed zero
require generated artifact paths to match the specialized ASCII descriptor and template selected by artifact role
require state rowIndex to be exactly 0..T-1 for ALL_STATE_EXACT or 0..B-1 for FINITE_B_SCHEDULE across ordered chunks
require schedule-spool rowIndex and finite state rowIndex to be identical one-to-one and preserve repeated state labels
require block state order to be a permutation of 0..q-1 and state membership to satisfy the reference specification
require candidateIndex 0..C-1, candidate equality to referenceSpec.candidates[candidateIndex], candidateRecords length C <= 5000, and tiedCandidateIndices length <= 5000
require exact component projections to bind exact rowIndex/componentIndex and finite replicate projections to bind productionReplicateId == finite rowIndex
require exact comparison rows to be T state rows plus one aggregate for T+1 total records
require normal finite comparison rows to be one observed row, B replicate rows, and one aggregate for B+2 total records

require observed-analytic-failure finite comparison to contain only observed index 0 and aggregate index 1 for exactly 2 records and require the terminal comparison manifest overallComparisonStatus=NOT_COMPARABLE
require fieldComparisons length <= 45016, diagnosticIndices length <= 256, and disagreementCodes to use only the fixed enum with at most 32 unique entries

require observed analytical failure only after a complete verified spool, then fail fast with primaryChunks=[], primaryLedgerBytes=0, logical empty SHA, executedStatisticScans=1, executedScheduledScans=0, unexecutedReplicateCount=B, and all valid/E/F/numerator/denominator/bound/p/decision fields null
require every finite plannedDenominator.source == DESIGN_CONSTANT and plannedDenominator.value == B+1, never a survivor-derived denominator
require the diagnostic stream to begin with one HEADER, contain only bounded EDGE/CODE/COUNTER/NUMERICAL_BOUNDARY rows, end with one FOOTER, and have contiguous diagnosticIndex values

require diagnosticRowIndex to be globally contiguous, bodyIndex to be contiguous within each diagnostic group, footer counts and hashes to bind its header and canonical body rows, and every header expected count to equal the emitted strict row variants
require every COUNTER row to carry exactly one strict ABZ/AZ/BZ/Z key variant, one implementationRole, one direction, and one positive count; reference counters must complete both directions

require AVAILABLE headers to use a null not-exposed reason and complete both PRODUCTION_SOURCE directions; require NOT_EXPOSED headers to use a fixed reason, expectedProductionCounterRecordCount=0, and no PRODUCTION_SOURCE Counter row
require implementationIdentities to contain exactly one REFERENCE_SOURCE, one PRODUCTION_SOURCE, and one COMPARISON_DRIVER identity
require axisStates to match exactly one legal oneOf combination and recompute package/comparison/diagnostic outcomes from retained evidence

require VERIFIED retained artifacts to have re-read bytes and sha256; UNVERIFIED artifacts have sha256 null and bytes either null or a nonnegative writer-observed count that is not exact custody evidence
require all DerivedOperands R/package/comparison/diagnostic/compute/io fields to be recomputed with guarded built-in-integer arithmetic; booleans are rejected
require contractBinding schema/upstream identities to match physical bytes while containing no current artifact self digest
require reserve, file fsync, same-directory atomic rename, and directory fsync metadata to agree with actual custody observations
require comparison-manifest.json and failure-manifest.json to be mutually exclusive terminal roots and forbid COMPLETE status over partial or unverified artifacts

FloatHex.description: Canonical finite IEEE-754 binary64 hexadecimal spelling; semantic verifier must enforce float.fromhex(value).hex() exact round trip.

x-semanticOnlyInvariants: T+1, B+2, and observed-failure 2 comparison cardinalities are cross-record semantic invariants
plannedDenominator.value equals B+1 and is a DESIGN_CONSTANT
implementation identity role uniqueness is checked semantically in addition to schema contains constraints
canonical float round trip, ledger digests, chunk continuity, row ordering, counter exposure, and custody observations are not established by JSON Schema alone
DerivedOperands formulas and all cross-field equalities require the semantic verifier
